svg.text: configuration (i): an AR LM over single-codebook semantic tokens, a flow decoder to mel, then a vocoder

g.text: the tokenizer is an ASR encoder with a quantiser inserted (FSQ, 6,561 codes), supervised by transcripts —
so the token leans to content; the flow puts the voice and the detail back — the more semantic the token, the more the flow repairs
streaming: text and speech tokens interleaved 5 : 15; the flow decodes chunk by chunk with a chunk-aware mask (§6)
tokens by AR, detail by flow
